description.zh:
数据开发工作流的唯一标识符。

><notice>该字段在SDK8.0.0版本之前为Long类型，SDK8.0.0版本及之后为String类型。**该变更不影响SDK正常使用，参数仍会按SDK中定义的类型返回**。只有在跨8.0.0版本的SDK升级时，类型变更可能会导致项目编译不通过，需要用户手动修正数据类型。></notice>
description.en:
The unique identifier of the Data Studio workflow.

> This field is of the Long type in SDK versions prior to 8.0.0, and of the String type in SDK versions 8.0.0 and later. This change does not affect normal SDK usage; the parameter will still be returned according to the type defined in the SDK. However, compilation failures may occur due to the type change only when upgrading the SDK across version 8.0.0. In this case, you must manually update the data type.

description.zh:
移动的目标路径，不需要带工作流名称。

例如将test工作流的路径变成到root/demo/test，则此参数需要填写root/demo
description.en:
The path to which you want to move the workflow. You do not need to specify a workflow name in the path.

For example, if you want to move the test workflow to root/demo/test, you must set this parameter to root/demo.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the ID. This parameter indicates the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied.

title.zh: 移动数据开发工作流路径
